truth.claim: two ways of stepping a planet a billion times: the energy-keeper never strays more than 0.007 %; the plain way is 1.9 % off after 10 million steps (about 270 times more) and the planet is thrown out by 65 million steps; the spin number holds to 11 places
truth.note: factory/topics/noether-applied/verlet_vs_rk4.c and recompute.py, A-grade derived; the two steppers share one orbit shell, then sort into a tube and a funnel

truth.claim: 10,000 training states (100 runs x 100 steps): weights travel 0.24, the layer gap moves 0.00095; two networks taught a spring at 200 units and 2,000 steps: energy error 170 (plain) vs 0.38 (energy-keeping), about 450 times
truth.note: Part 1's network data (recompute) and Greydanus et al. 2019 Table 1 read from snippets (grade B); counts before the ratios

truth.claim: a loop of air stretches and folds while its swirl stays (wall height moves under 0.14 %); one protein chain of 2,180 residues turns and its answer arrows turn with it
truth.note: the loop is a film-local stirred mesh (simulated, tagged); the chain is a seeded stand-in, tagged 'not the real fold'; residue count from the source structure
